paper.title: Gaussian Mean Field Variational Inference can Overestimate Predictive Variance

claims.paper_statement: MFVI can underestimate posterior variance while overestimating predictive variance.
claims.scope: 144 synthetic systems and 9 UCI datasets under the spherical-prior setup; the nonspherical-prior control is negative.

claims.paper_statement: Expected predictive variance is larger for MFVI on the training distribution.
claims.scope: Positive finite synthetic and retained-UCI gaps; the empirical training-distribution assumption remains explicit.

claims.paper_statement: The overestimation appears in concentrated directions.
claims.scope: First principal direction in the declared prior/data setup; not an unrestricted all-priors claim.

official_code.note: The independent verifier does not import the official posterior implementation; the full-scale official output is retained and read back.

publication_policy: Publish the scoped independent audit and retained full-scale evidence with external-code/data and prior/distribution limits; do not claim a fresh nine-dataset run, formal-proof replacement, score, or author endorsement.
